# Match two clips that look different

- Kind: `recipe`
- Category: `studio`
- Slug: `studio/match-two-clips`

## Summary

Darkroom recipe (intermediate). Pick the better clip as the reference and move the other towards it: exposure first, then temperature and tint, then saturation.

## Details

### When to use
Two cameras or two lighting setups in one edit.
### What a pro does and why
Pick the better clip as the reference and move the other towards it: exposure first, then temperature and tint, then saturation. Comparing preview frames side by side is the professional method; Medi sees one frame at a time, so it fixes the obvious difference and asks.
### Ops
```json
{
  "summary": "Match clip to reference",
  "ops": [
    {"op": "grade", "clipIds": ["CLIP_B"], "lumetri": {"exposure": 0.3, "temperature": -12, "tint": 3, "saturation": 0.95}}
  ]
}
```
The values come from comparing the two clips: the example warms down and brightens a clip that was darker and warmer than the reference.
### How to adjust
Still different: move the playhead to each clip and send a frame of both. Overcorrected: halve the numbers.
